address: OBA Javaplein, Javaplein 2, Amsterdam (2011; library in the ground floor of a perimeter housing block, one pand)
notes: 2011 perimeter housing block (pand 0363100012238726, 343 LoD2.2 wall surfaces, 98 m long) with the OBA Javaplein library on its ground floor; the whole pand is modelled. South front (surfaces 130/343, 2017-04-04 panorama, 18 m away): pale pink brick with grey-brick piers, paired windows with stone lintels and rail balustrades, a two-storey arcade ground with shopfronts and a double-height glazed bay with an orange wooden door (the library entrance); north long front (2020-09-08 panorama) five brick storeys over a shopfront plinth with a dormer storey; SW and E fronts the same brick grid.

Ornaments: OBA lettering SIMPLIFIED (kit canopy lettering 'OBA' in OBA red over the entrance hall; the 2017 panorama shows no OBA sign on this front, so this is the library identity, not a photographed sign); orange entrance door MODELLED as the door colour; grey-brick piers MODELLED as piers; arcade canopy slabs over the shopfronts SIMPLIFIED (entrance canopy and shopfront plinth only); stone lintels and balcony rails SKIPPED (too-small); dormer row on the north front SKIPPED (3DBAG roof carries the volume); shop signs and awnings SKIPPED (temporary); the 3DBAG tower/stair volume (roof max 36 m) is kept as surveyed.

Only 359 openings fit the 12k budget on a 98 m block: the north front uses 26 bays per storey (real pitch is finer) and frames:false (dark frames read as glass) on the long fronts. Courtyard and party walls have no panorama and stay blank (otherWalls).
